target.title: Separate speech capability controls from voice settings
target.body: ## Summary - Problem: Speech provider/model controls were split between Permissions and Voice & Audio, making Permissions feel like a duplicate configuration surface. - Why it matters: Capabilities should gate agent access, while Voice & Audio should own model, provider, voice, and language setup. - What changed: Removed speech provider setup from Permissions, added a conditional Voice & Audio link with tailored setup warnings, made Permissions the owner of STT/TTS capability toggles, and kept Voice & Audio settings interactive while showing capability notices. - User impact: Users configure speech models/voices in Voice & Audio and enable or disable agent STT/TTS access in Permissions. - What did NOT change (scope boundary): No MCP command shape, gateway behavior, persisted credential storage, or node capability registration changes. ## Change Type (select all) - [x] Bug fix - [x] Feature - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Docs / instructions - [x] Tests / validation - [ ] Security hardening - [ ] Chore / infra ## Scope (select all touched areas) - [x] Tray / WinUI UX - [ ] Windows node capability - [ ] Local MCP / `winnode` - [ ] Gateway / connection / pairing - [ ] Setup / onboarding - [x] Permissions / privacy / security - [x] Tests / CI / docs ## Linked Issue/PR - Closes # - Related # - [ ] Related to a bug or regression ## Validation - `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter CapabilitiesPageLocalizationCoverageTests` — 7 passed, 0 skipped - `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter "SpeechInputContractTests|LocalizationValidationTests"` — 18 passed, 0 skipped - `$env:OPENCLAW_REPO_ROOT=(Get-Location).Path; .\build.ps1` — all builds succeeded - `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Shared.Tests\OpenClaw.Shared.Tests.csproj --no-restore` — 2703 passed, 31 skipped - `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests.csproj --no-restore` — 1576 passed, 0 skipped ## Real behavior proof - Environment tested: Windows ARM64 local worktree - PR head / commit tested: `4c0d9e61` - Exact steps or command run: Automated validation commands above; manual screenshot proof added by PR author. - Evidence after fix: Validation confirms localized Permissions/Voice & Audio contracts, warning copy, absence of duplicated provider controls, both Voice & Audio Permissions links, and split chat microphone recovery: disabled STT opens Permissions while missing STT model opens Voice & Audio. - Observed result: Permissions owns STT/TTS capability toggles; Voice & Audio owns speech model/provider/voice setup and stays configurable while disabled-capability notices are shown. ### Screenshots - Permissions: TTS setup warning to download/select a voice. - Permissions: STT setup warning to download a speech model. - Permissions: combined warning when both STT model and TTS voice are missing. - Permissions: plain Voice & Audio link when enabled capabilities are fully configured. - Permissions: no Voice & Audio link or warnings when both STT/TTS capabilities are disabled. - Voice & Audio: warning notices that STT/TTS capabilities must be enabled in Permissions. Rubber-duck / Hanselman review notes: dual-model adversarial review found no high-consensus correctness/security issues. Follow-up fixes addressed stale STT description copy, kept Voice & Audio configuration interactive while showing capability notices, tightened localization coverage for both Permissions links, and routed disabled microphone recovery to Permissions while keeping missing-model recovery in Voice & Audio. ## Security Impact (required) - New permissions/capabilities?
